apps.title: Pure Crime: Gangster City RP
apps.summary:
Rule the Streets. Live Your Way.
Enter the world of Pure Crime, an open-world gangster action adventure where crime, cars and chaos are all part of everyday life. Explore a huge city, build your Reputation and rise from small-time crook to the most feared name on the streets!

Make the city your playground in an open world full of action and opportunity. Steal cars, battle rival gangs, escape intense police chases and free roam however you like. Race through traffic, take on jobs, earn cash and discover new ways to get ahead. Whether you're causing chaos or making an honest living, every hustle brings you closer to the top.

Dive into urban crime in this action game. Take on gangs, mobsters and mafia crews in third-person shootouts and chase them down in fast cars. Every choice shapes your story in the city.

Build your Reputation and unlock the city! Complete Activities, take on rivals and cause chaos to earn Reputation, level up and unlock new jobs, powerful weapons, incredible vehicles, new outfits, player housing and entire districts. The more you play, the more opportunities open up, with new places to explore and bigger rewards to chase!

Want some action? Grab a weapon, steal a car and take on the streets. Fancy something different? Race through the city, drive a taxi, deliver pizzas or discover another way to make cash. In Pure Crime, there's always something happening and a new way to build your legend.

Key Features
• Open-World Crime Sandbox - Explore a city packed with action, danger and opportunity. Free roam wherever you want, cause chaos and find your own way to the top.
• Third-Person Shooter Action - Fight your rivals in fast gunfights and shootouts across the city.
• Build Your Reputation - Earn Reputation through Activities, combat and open-world chaos. Level up to unlock new cars, weapons, outfits, jobs, housing and districts.
• Crime, Gangs and Police Chases - Battle rival gangs, steal vehicles and escape the law as your Wanted Level rises.
• Jobs, Races and Activities - Take on street races, taxi driving, deliveries, wanted targets and more. Every Activity offers a new way to earn rewards.
• Cars, Bikes, Helicopters and More! - Drive, steal and collect vehicles, from everyday rides to high-performance cars and special vehicles.
• Weapons, Shooting and Customisation - Collect and upgrade weapons, unlock new looks and create your own style.
• Unlock New Districts and Homes - Rise through the Reputation ranks to unlock new areas of the city, claim new homes and expand your world.
• PvP and Clans - Take on other players in competitive battles, team up in a clan and climb the leaderboards.
• Regular Updates - New Activities, vehicles, weapons and features keep the world of Pure Crime growing.

Build your Reputation. Own the streets. Become a legend.
Download Pure Crime, the open-world gangster RP game, and start your rise to the top!

Note: Internet connection required to play.

apps.title: Wordsect - Word Puzzle Games
apps.summary:
Wordsect combines crossword puzzles with connected letter tiles and satisfying tile breaks. Find words on the letter board, fill the crossword grid, and plan which tiles to use next.

The numbers change how you play. Each tile has a limited number of uses, shown on its face. Use a tile to form a word and its count goes down. When the count reaches zero, it cracks and crumbles. A word that fits now may use letters you need later, so look beyond your next answer.

HOW TO PLAY
- Connect neighboring letters up, down, left, or right to form words.
- Find words that fit the crossword grid.
- Check the numbers to track each tile's remaining uses.
- Watch a tile break apart when its count reaches zero.

CROSSWORDS WITH AN EXTRA CHALLENGE
Solving the crossword is only part of the puzzle. Explore letter paths and consider how each word affects the tiles still available. Put vocabulary, spelling, and planning together as you work towards a completed grid.

A SATISFYING WAY TO FIND WORDS
Letter tiles crack and crumble when they are used up, giving each puzzle a distinctive visual rhythm. Enjoy the word-finding challenge and the satisfying break-apart moments along the way.

LARGE LETTERS, READABLE COUNTS
See the letters and remaining-use numbers clearly as you study the board. Compare possible connections, choose a word, and make your next move.

If you enjoy crossword games and connecting letters, try a word puzzle where finding an answer and choosing a path go hand in hand.

Connect the letters. Complete the crossword. Enjoy the crumble.

apps.title: Factifact: Trivia Word Puzzle
apps.summary:
Factifact is a trivia word puzzle that turns fun facts into wordplay. 🔍 Each short fact hides some of its words inside brackets. Read the definitions, find the missing words and reveal the whole fact.

How does a Factifact word game work? A fact appears with some words, or parts of words, hidden in brackets. Each bracket holds a short definition of a missing word. Read it and guess the word from four options. No typing is needed, so these logic puzzles stay smooth and focused. Definitions are nested three or four layers deep. The answer to an inner definition becomes a word in the outer one. It feels like trivia questions stacked inside each other. Every word you find brings you closer to interesting facts about the world. 🧠 Think of them as word riddles that test your vocabulary.

Factifact works like a reverse crossword without a grid. ⛏️ Classic crossword puzzles give you a clue and a row of empty squares. Here you start from the clue and dig down to the hidden word. Fans of word puzzle games will feel at home right away. Every brainteaser blends vocabulary, reasoning and general knowledge in one sequence. Short brain teasers like these make a calm mental workout at any time.

Guess the word correctly and the next layer of the puzzle opens. Unlike most word quiz games, every answer becomes part of the next clue. These trivia questions reward careful reading and patient thinking. Solving puzzles here feels like piecing a small story together. What you will find inside:
💡 A hint when a clue feels too tricky
❤️ Three hearts per fact, so every guess counts
🏺 A dig site that uncovers a hidden find with each solved word
📌 A board where every solved fact is pinned as a colorful note
🎉 Confetti, fireworks and kind words when a fact is fully revealed

The facts cover nature, geography, animals and much more. 🏺 One puzzle explains why honey can stay fresh for centuries. Another shows how Mount Everest is still growing. If you enjoy crossword puzzles, these little discoveries will surprise you. Factifact brings word puzzle games and general knowledge together. Expect brain teasers that are short, fair and satisfying to crack.

Facts unlock one after another, and any solved fact can be reread later. 📌 Some logic puzzles are gentle, while others are real brainteasers with deep nesting. A wrong answer costs a heart, so read each clue carefully. Love word quiz games, solving puzzles and interesting facts? 🎉 Factifact is waiting for you.

apps.title: Arrow Story: Home Design
apps.summary:
Welcome to Arrow Story: Home Design! A relaxing arrow puzzle game that trains your brain.
SOS! A woman and her dog lost their home to a fire. A family is caught in a blizzard. They need your help.
Come to Arrow Story: Home Design. Solve arrow puzzles, collect stars, and help people in need rebuild their homes and get back to happy lives.
It's a heartfelt arrow puzzle game where every level brings a change you can see. Spend the stars you earn to repair their broken homes until the place looks new again. One repair at a time, you put their lives back together.
➡️ Arrow Puzzle Gameplay
Arrows cover every grid, and each one can only travel the way it points. That means one arrow can block another. Study the layout, spot which arrows are in the way, and find the order that clears the board.
An arrow leaves once its path is open. Tap a blocked one and it counts as a mistake. Every level pays 1 to 3 stars, and fewer mistakes mean more stars. Stars are your score and your building budget. Every star moves the story forward, and the more you earn, the faster you can build. Fail a level and you lose a heart. Early levels teach the rules. Later ones make you think. Hard and super-hard levels put your planning to the test.
💡 Helpers for Tricky Grids
A tight grid doesn't have to stop you. Four helpers are ready: Hint, Eraser, Magic Wand, and Full Grid Zoom.
✨ Why Choose Arrow Story: Home Design
• ⭐ Arrow puzzles with a real payoff: every grid you clear pays stars
• 🔨 Builds you can see: every repair brings the place closer to new, and helps someone who needs it
• ☕ No rush: no timer, so you can take all the time you need
• 📴 Offline play: works without Wi-Fi or mobile data
Take a break with Arrow Story: Home Design. Calm a restless mind, fill a few spare minutes, ease the pressure of the day, and enjoy a puzzle without stress. Along the way, you help people, follow their stories, and feel what a little help can do.
If you like arrow puzzles, arrow escape games, and stories about helping others, this one is for you.
Someone is waiting. Download Arrow Story: Home Design now and start helping people who need it.

apps.title: Tidy Room!
apps.summary:
A bedroom floor full of stray things. A kitchen counter lost under mugs. A study where nothing made it back to the shelf. Tidy Room! hands you the mess and a few baskets, and asks you to put it right.

Each basket names what it wants. Hunt through the room, tap the right things, and watch the clutter disappear. Objects hide under other objects, so the fun is in the order: what do you pick up first?

Play at your own pace. There is no countdown, just a room that looks better every time you find the thing a basket asked for.

What you will do
• Explore illustrated rooms, from quiet studies to busy kitchens
• Fill baskets by finding the items they ask for
• Dig through piles to reach what is hidden underneath
• Plan your taps so the tray does not overflow
• Clear one level and start the next

One room at a time, until the house feels like home again.

apps.title: Krillion Trivia & Word Game
apps.summary:
Seven questions. One ocean. How deep can your knowledge take you?

Krillion is a daily trivia and word game where a correct answer is only the beginning. Each prompt has many possible answers. Your challenge is to find one that other players might overlook. The rarer your answer, the more points you earn and the deeper you dive.

A QUICK QUIZ WITH A TWIST
Take on seven prompts with 25 seconds to answer each one. No multiple-choice lists: type your own answer, think fast, and make every round count. Each point takes you 10 meters deeper, with a perfect dive reaching 7,000 meters.

DAILY CHALLENGE & UNLIMITED PLAY
Try the same daily set as other players, then return for a fresh challenge each day. Want more? Unlimited mode brings more seven-question games whenever you are ready for another dive.

FIND YOUR ONE IN A KRILLION
Discover six answer tiers, from everyday Plankton to Rare, Deep Cut, and One in a Krillion. Explore the accepted answers after your dive and uncover the possibilities you missed.

BUILD YOUR DIVING HABIT
Track your daily streak, completed dives, best score, and recent results. Keep your streak going to unlock new dive buddies. Share a spoiler-free score summary so friends can try the questions for themselves.

MADE FOR CURIOUS MINDS
Enjoy a pixel-art ocean, playful sea creatures, sound effects, and settings for reduced animation and colorblind-friendly colors. Answer checking recognizes alternative names and small spelling slips, with AI helping check valid answers beyond the prepared lists.

Bring your general knowledge, quick thinking, and a few unexpected ideas. Your next great answer could be one in a Krillion.

apps.title: Word Mahjong - Relaxing Puzzle
apps.summary:
Take a break, connect some letters, and enjoy a little wordplay with Word Mahjong!

Word Mahjong is a relaxing word puzzle game that’s easy to learn and fun to master. With clever puzzles and peaceful backgrounds, it’s a welcoming place to unwind and put your vocabulary to the test.

There’s no timer and no pressure to rush. Take your time, explore different letter combinations, and enjoy the satisfaction of finding the word that completes the puzzle.

HOW TO PLAY

Connect letter tiles to form words and fill every blank on the board. Each tile has a small number showing how many times you need to use that letter. Keep an eye on these numbers as you work through each puzzle—they add a thoughtful twist to classic crossword gameplay!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORD MAHJONG

• Simple to start, satisfying to master
Learn the basics quickly, then discover new challenges as you progress.

• Hundreds of word puzzles
Explore increasingly challenging levels that put your spelling and vocabulary to the test.

• Play at your own pace
Enjoy every puzzle without time limits, whether you have a few minutes or a whole evening.

• Peaceful, beautiful backgrounds
Settle into calming scenery while you search for your next word.

• Fun for all ages
From casual players to longtime word puzzle fans, everyone can enjoy the pleasure of solving a clever puzzle.

If you enjoy crosswords, word connect games, or simply a quiet moment with words, make Word Mahjong part of your day.

Download Word Mahjong and start connecting. How many words will you discover?

apps.summary:
Bingo Rise is designed for people who find regular alarms too easy to ignore.
If you often hit snooze, turn alarms off half awake, or fall back asleep after a quick tap, Bingo Rise is built to make mornings more active. - Choose one-time alarms or repeating schedules
- Set your preferred ringtone and vibration options
- Dismiss alarms normally or with a Bingo challenge
- Pick different Bingo challenge levels for different wake-up needs
- Manage everything in a clean and easy-to-use layout

apps.title: Hidden Christmas: Find Objects
apps.summary:
Search festive pictures and find hidden objects in Hidden Christmas: Find Objects. Zoom into snowy villages, cozy cabins, and decorated homes, then tap each item on your list. No timer. Play at your own pace.

🎄 How to play
Each scene shows the objects you need to find. Pinch to zoom, drag across the picture, and tap what you spot. Some items sit in plain sight. Others blend into the lights, gifts, and furniture, so the fun is in looking twice. If you get stuck, use a hint and keep going.

A round is simple. Open a Christmas picture, check the list, and search until every object is found. Larger items help you settle in. Smaller ones ask for a closer look. When the list is clear, move on to the next scene. Nothing is counting down while you search.

🎅 Christmas scenes to explore
Move through snowy villages, Christmas workshops, gift-filled rooms, glowing streets, and warm living rooms. You will see sparkling trees, snowy rooftops, festive windows, and rooms full of holiday color.

The pictures are not copies of one living room. A quiet cabin, a busy workshop, a decorated dining room, and a street lined with lights each hide objects in different places. The clutter, the colors, and the corners worth checking all change.

🎁 What you will find
Look for the details that make a scene feel like Christmas: ornaments, wrapped presents, candy canes, stockings, bells, wreaths, gingerbread, and snowflakes. Santa, elves, reindeer, and snowmen show up among the garlands, along with mittens, scarves, snow globes, and pine trees.

Check the mantel, the table, the windowsill, and the edge of the room. Holiday objects sit inside the picture, mixed in with decorations, furniture, and wrapped gifts.

❄️ A calm Christmas hidden object game
Hidden Christmas is a relaxing seek-and-find game for a short break or a longer cozy session. Finish one list, then come back later for another winter scene.

It is an easy holiday puzzle when you want something festive without a timer, and a closer search when you feel like examining every corner. Play for a few minutes, or stay with a picture until the last object turns up.

If you like Christmas games, hidden object puzzles, and holiday seek-and-find pictures, start with one scene and see what you notice.

Live your basketball career from high school to the pros in BallSZN, said "Ball Season". Play real 3v3 basketball games, get recruited by colleges, hear your name on draft night and chase the Hall of Fame in a career simulator that plays fully offline.

HIGH SCHOOL TO THE PROS
Start in your parents' backyard with a ball and a hoop. Earn your recruiting stars in high school, pick your college on signing day and hear your name called on draft night. Make the league or fight your way up from the Development League, negotiate in free agency and chase a ring, all the way to the Hall of Fame.

REAL BASKETBALL GAMES, FAST
Every game day is a real 3v3 game with five a side: two 2-minute halves, 2s and 3s, a 12-second shot clock. Start on the bench, earn your minutes and stay on the floor by how you play. Move with your left thumb, hold SHOOT to rise and let go at the top of the jump on the timing meter. A game takes about five minutes and seasons are short, so you play the moments that matter, not 48-minute grinds.

HOW YOU PLAY DECIDES YOUR ROLE
After every game a teammate grade, A+ to F, judges what you did: the makes, the extra pass, the stops and the boards. It sets your XP and what your coach thinks of you, and teammates who trust you look for you more. Every teammate and opponent has his own game and his own numbers, and they grow, fade and move on between seasons.

BUILD YOUR PLAYER
Pick one of six player types, from Sharpshooter and Slasher to Playmaker and Iceman. Practice with the team, run the drills and watch your stats and OVR climb. Earn your role from the bench up to Star and Franchise Player.

LIFE AROUND THE COURT
Keep your coach, your teammates, the fans, your girlfriend and your sponsors happy, and see it all on the feed. Earn a salary and playoff bonuses, upgrade your home court from the backyard to your own facility, and save up for the house.

QUICK PLAY
Just want a game? Jump into a 1v1 or a 3v3 basketball game whenever you like.

FAIR BY DESIGN
- Plays offline, no wifi needed. No account, no sign-in.
- Your basketball career is saved on your device, so no server shutdown can ever take it away.
- No VC and no pay-to-win. No ads. The whole career is free, with one optional purchase: BallSZN Pro.
- No energy timers.

Teams are named only after real cities and states. No real leagues, team names, logos or players are used, and nothing is licensed from or endorsed by any league.

apps.title: UnGodly
apps.summary:
UnGodly is a dark fantasy action RPG where you control every strike, dodge and hero swap in real-time combat. Collect Primals, build your team and fight to save a world being devoured.

The world of Dunmiir is broken. The Devouring consumes what remains, and only the Primals, scarred warriors who wield elemental power, stand between humanity and extinction. This is a mature action RPG built for players who want real action, deep progression and a story with teeth.

REAL-TIME ACTION COMBAT
Every fight is in your hands. Dodge enemy attacks, swap heroes mid-battle, chain ultimates and trigger elemental reactions to break your enemies apart. Combat is fast, heavy and bloody: cut down foes, sever heads and limbs, and earn every victory through skill and timing. If you love hack and slash action games, UnGodly delivers combat with real weight.

COLLECT AND BUILD YOUR PRIMALS
Recruit Primals, warriors shaped by trauma and power, each built for a distinct combat role. Level them up, upgrade gear, unlock awakenings and customize skills to create your own builds. This hero collector RPG rewards experimentation: every Primal opens new team synergies and new ways to play.

A DARK FANTASY WORLD WORTH SAVING
Explore Dunmiir, a shattered fantasy realm ruled by dangerous factions and corrupted gods. Follow a mature story told through cinematic missions, side quests and character-driven role play. Every chapter of this dark fantasy RPG pulls you deeper into a world of blood, betrayal and survival.

BOSSES, EVENTS AND THE NETHERMAW DESCENT
Face brutal bosses that test your mastery of real-time combat. Take on evolving challenges and live events, then push into the Nethermaw Descent and climb the leaderboards to prove your skill.

DEEP RPG PROGRESSION
UnGodly is a true role playing game at its core. Gear, skills, awakenings, story choices and team synergy all feed long-term progression, so every session moves your Primals forward. Play in focused daily sessions or dive in for hours.

BUILT FOR ACTION RPG FANS
If you play role playing games for the combat and the story, and want an action RPG with skill-based fights, a collection of powerful heroes and a dark story worth following, UnGodly is your next game.

Download UnGodly and fight for what remains.

apps.title: Amochiroom Puzzle: Room Sort
apps.summary:
In Amochiroom Puzzle: Room Sort, turn everyday clutter into a satisfying sorting puzzle.

Explore cozy rooms, find the items your boxes need, and tap matching objects to pack them away. Read each box label and choose what to collect next. Items without a matching box wait in limited temporary slots, so a little planning helps you keep making space.

Find it. Sort it.
Look through piles of familiar objects and match them to the right boxes. Decide which items to collect first as you work through each room.

A place for your next move
Keep an eye on your temporary slots. Make thoughtful choices before they fill up, and clear space for the next objects.

Rooms with their own character
Discover living rooms, kitchens, pet corners, cafés, and other themed spaces filled with everyday things to sort.

Enjoy the tidy finish
Complete puzzles, earn stars, and revisit earlier rooms to improve your best times.

Play your way
Choose from multiple interface languages and adjust music, sound effects, and vibration. Your progress is saved on your device, and no account registration is required.

Amochiroom Puzzle is free to play and contains ads. Optional rewarded ads can provide extra space, helpful tools, or energy; interstitial ads may appear between levels. Ads and optional feedback require an internet connection.

apps.title: SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten
apps.summary:
Ready for a new kind of Mahjong puzzle? 🀄

SoEasy Mahjong 2: Make Ten combines classic Mahjong tile matching with a fun number puzzle twist. Match identical tiles, pair special tiles, or combine number tiles to make 10. Find the right matches, clear the board, and enjoy a fresh puzzle experience with every level.

Mahjong Matching with a Twist

Discover more ways to match and clear tiles:

• Match Identical Tiles — Find two tiles with the same design and clear the pair.

• Make 10 — Combine two number tiles that add up to 10, such as 8 + 2, 6 + 4, or 7 + 3.

• Match Special Tiles — Spot themed tiles and pair matching designs to clear the board.

Each board offers different matching opportunities. Look carefully, choose your next move, and find the best way to clear the tiles. 🔍

Easy to Learn, Fun to Solve

Enjoy the familiar look of Mahjong tiles with a fresh tile-matching puzzle mechanic. Whether you prefer spotting identical tiles or finding number pairs that add up to 10, every move gives you a new way to approach the board.

The rules are simple to understand, but finding the right matches takes observation and planning. Think ahead, explore different combinations, and enjoy the satisfaction of clearing tiles one pair at a time.

How to Play

• Find tiles that can be matched.
• Pair identical Mahjong tiles or matching special tiles.
• Combine two number tiles that add up to 10.
• Choose your matches carefully to clear the board.
• Complete each puzzle by clearing the tiles.

Match, Think & Relax 🍃

Looking for a relaxing Mahjong puzzle, a casual tile-matching game, or a fun number puzzle? SoEasy Mahjong 2 brings them together in one easy-to-play experience.

Enjoy familiar Mahjong-style tiles, satisfying matches, and the added challenge of making 10. Take your time, find the right combinations, and clear each board at your own pace.

Start your Mahjong puzzle journey today and see how far you can go! 🎯

apps.title: Pit Crew Tycoon - Garage Boss
apps.summary:
Run an idle garage tycoon and turn a roadside tire shop into a car repair empire.

Cars roll in, your crew services them bay by bay, and every job pays. Upgrade your stations, hire mechanics and watch the profits climb from pocket change to numbers with a lot of zeros. The garage keeps working while you are away, so there is always cash waiting when you come back.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE EMPIRE
Start at the Tire Shop in Sprocket Bay, then rebuild into Paint Works, Muscle Mile and Truck Town. Expand to a second city, Throttle Coast, with Beach Buggy Bay, Lowrider Lane, Supercar Strip and Nitro Nights. That makes 8 garages across 2 cities, each with its own six stations, cars and crew.

UPGRADE FOR BIGGER PROFITS
Every station level raises its payout, and every 10th level doubles it. Buy one-time Garage Upgrades for faster service, more profit and more customers. There is always a next upgrade within reach.

HIRE A LEGENDARY CREW
Put up to three mechanics on a station and rank them up from Rookie to Legend. Hire a Foreman and the station runs itself.

EARN WHILE YOU SLEEP
Close the app and the Overnight Shift keeps paying. Come back, collect, and double it with a bonus video if you like.

OPEN TOOLBOXES, WIN GEAR
Collect 32 Mechanic Gear cards (caps, overalls, gloves and mascots) from Common to Legendary. Wear them for permanent profit bonuses and level up your favorites.

TROPHIES BOOST PROFIT FOREVER
Every garage you rebuild earns a trophy, and every trophy adds 10% to all your profit for good.

CLEAR GOALS, NO PRESSURE
Work Orders always show what to build next. Hit star milestones, take on Jobs and daily missions, and fill your car collection book. No lives and no fail states.

Pit Crew Tycoon is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases, including Gems and Toolboxes with random Gear cards. The No Ads purchase removes ad breaks, and bonus videos stay optional.

Grab your wrench and build the garage of your dreams.

apps.title: Word Tiles - Daily Escape
apps.summary:
Make room for a little word discovery with Word Tiles - Daily Escape. Connect letter tiles, uncover hidden words, and enjoy a change of scenery as you work through each board.

🧩 A small number, a clever clue
Swipe between neighboring letters to build words, moving up, down, left, or right. The small number on each tile shows how many remaining target words use it. Follow those clues, fill the word spaces, and watch tiles disappear as you find the answers. A familiar letter can be part of more than one solution, so take another look before your next swipe.

🔎 More to discover on the board

apps.title: GoreBox 27
apps.summary:
GoreBox 27 is a physics sandbox shooter. Every character is a GoreDoll: a full ragdoll with its own skeleton, organs and blood.

Play alone, against bots or online with other players.

DAMAGE
• Damage is tracked per body part: broken bones, failing organs and blood loss from each wound
• Lose the arm holding a gun and the gun falls. Lose the legs or break the spine and the GoreDoll crawls
• Knockouts, concussions and bleeding out, with GoreDolls that wake up and get back on their feet
• Blades and axes take off arms, legs and heads, and explosions tear bodies apart
• Wounds and burns stay on bodies, and blood stays on the ground
• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

WEAPONS AND PROPS
• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

BOTS AND NPCS
• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender
• Bots take cover, react to gunshots, search where they last saw you, fight with melee weapons and man turrets
• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

MULTIPLAYER
• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

GAMEMODES
• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

GoreBox 27 contains graphic violence, blood and gore, and online interaction with other players. It is not made for children.

• Your own character takes the same damage, down to bruises and torn clothing
• The Body Inspector shows a body's vitals and organ function, and Status Indicators show how your character feels

FIRE, EXPLOSIVES AND RADIATION
• Fire spreads through grass, wood, cloth and spilled fuel, and smoke fills rooms and chokes GoreDolls
• GoreDolls catch fire and burn to death unless the fire is put out
• Explosives from propane tanks and gas cans to missiles, the Neutron Bottle and the Aerial Bomb, a nuclear bomb
• Radioactive fallout drifts with the wind, causes radiation sickness and can turn GoreDolls into Mutants

• Firearms with recoil and handling based on real calibres
• Bullets go through walls, depending on the calibre and the wall's thickness
• 25 melee weapons, from the Katana to the Frying Pan, with heavy swings and blocking
• The Reality Crusher: grab anything physical, fling it, tear it apart or crush it, and build fences and walls
• Over 200 props, including turrets, TVs, live cameras, jump pads and teleporters

• Ten kinds of NPC, from Regulars and Officers to Convicts, Maniacs, Mutants and Divines, each with its own background. Some fight back, some run and some surrender

• Set each NPC's skill, and save an NPC with its weapons, look and side as your own spawn card

• Crossplay between PC and mobile
• Host a game for friends, invite them from your friends list, or browse public servers
• Dedicated servers, LAN games, voice and text chat, and vote-kicks
• Hosts set the rules, kick players, sell roles and run their server's own money, GB$
• Clans, each with its own bank and emblem

• Sandbox, with no rules or objectives
• Free for all, Team deathmatch, Gun Game, Maniac Mystery, Infection, Mutant survival, Juggernaut, Riot, Invasion and more
• Bots can fill in for players in any gamemode
• Make your own gamemodes from triggers and actions, with lives, teams, zones and secret roles

WORLD
• Day and night, with a moon that goes through its phases, and clouds, rain and storms
• A car to drive, which hurts whoever it hits and whoever is inside when it crashes

CREATE YOUR OWN
• Build maps in the Map Editor on PC, with houses, working doors, lifts and water to swim in, and play them straight away
• Publish maps on the Workshop and play the ones other players made
• Save a scene with everything built in it, its NPCs and where everyone stands, and load it again later
• Customise your character down to the face, with hairstyles, beards, hats, masks and clothes in any colour

Full controller support, and touch controls on mobile.

EARLY ACCESS
This is an early access version of GoreBox 27. You will run into bugs, and parts of the game are unfinished or still missing. Nothing you see here is final.

GoreBox 27 is only a few months old and has far less content than GoreBox Animosity for now. New updates will keep adding more. If you find a bug, please report it on our Discord server.

apps.title: The Last Walk: Survival Story
apps.summary:
The Last Walk is a zombie survival story game with real choices, set in a post-apocalyptic world. The army is evacuating the last civilians. Your wife and daughter climb onto the last truck. There is no room for you.

So you walk. Through dead suburbs, empty highways and burnt-out towns, all the way to the coast, across the sea, onto an island under siege, and beyond. More than 30 days of walking through a world overrun by zombies, and the story isn't over yet.

EVERY ENCOUNTER IS A CHOICE
A wounded stranger begs for a bandage. A lost child is starving. Raiders block the road. A bear escaped from the zoo sleeps across your path. A supermarket hands out free food, a little too freely. Swipe left or right: help or walk away, fight or run, trust or lie. Every choice changes your supplies, your health and the man you become.

SURVIVE THE ROAD
- Manage water, food and health: the road drains them every hour.
- Search the ruins, then buy and sell gear at the traders and markets.
- Arm yourself: nail bat, crowbar, machete, revolver, pump shotgun. Upgrade and reload them at the traders.
- Find a shelter before nightfall, or spend the night outside and fight the zombies, the Prowlers, until dawn.
- Meet people who walk with you for a while, and a stray dog who could change everything.

A FATHER'S STORY
Your family is alive, somewhere ahead. Keep your humanity or keep everything for yourself: the people you help, the ones you leave behind and the risks you take decide where your story goes.

MORE STORIES IN THE SAME WORLD
Other survivors walk other roads. Their stories take place in the same world and cross the main story. Unlock them by playing the main story or by paying.

FEATURES
- A zombie survival game and an interactive story, with real choices and no right answer
- More than 30 days of walking, and the story continues
- Several more stories to unlock by playing the main story or by paying
- Night fights, markets, weapons to upgrade and supplies to manage
- A side-scrolling pixel-art world with animated scenes
- Free to play, in short sessions
- Available in 31 languages

apps.title: Wordeex
apps.summary:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES
Play in your own language or try one you’re learning. Each language has a dictionary of 3,000 common words. Some will feel familiar. Others might become new favorites.

ALL GAME CONTENT IS FREE
Earn coins by completing puzzles and spend them on hints to help you outside Academy. Wordeex includes ads and optional in-app purchases for coins, ad removal and bundles. You can also choose to watch a rewarded ad after solving a puzzle to double your coin reward.

Think you’ve cracked it?
Find the hidden words. Use every letter. Solve the Wordeex.

Terms and Conditions: https://wordeex.com/terms/

• Score tracking so you can keep beating your personal best
• Clean, colorful soccer stadium graphics

Whether you're a big football fan or just want a fun way to pass the time, every kick is a chance to be the hero of the shootout.

Download Penalty Kicks Launcher, step up to the spot and score!

apps.title: PAW Patrol: The Game NETFLIX
apps.summary:
NETFLIX MEMBERSHIP REQUIRED. AD-FREE, UNLIMITED ACCESS FOR NETFLIX MEMBERS.

Ride along with the brave pups of PAW Patrol in this game for young kids. Help out with rescue missions, lend a paw at the pet salon and much more.

Join the PAW Patrol for playful adventures! Kids can dive into open-ended play, coloring and more with their favorite PAW Patrol pups in this interactive mobile experience designed for preschoolers. With engaging playsets and exciting Helping Paws missions, children can explore and lend a friendly paw all around Adventure Bay.

With no right or wrong way to play, kids are free to create, tell their own stories, discover at their own pace and learn the value of community service and teamwork — all alongside the PAW Patrol! No ads. No Wi-Fi required. Just flexible, imaginative fun.

In this kid-friendly game, little ones can explore the following vibrant playsets filled with surprises, coloring, silly interactions and opportunities to build, discover and create:

• The Lookout: Experience transformative vehicle play as you drive around the Lookout with the PAW Patrol!
• Katie's Pet Parlor: Help Katie run her pet shop. Bathe pups, style a new look or help customers purchase items from the store.
• Rocky's Garage: Green means go with Rocky and friends! Repair vehicles, have a dance party and turn junk-pile trash into treasure.
• Porter's Café: Step inside and become a chef. Fire up delicious pizzas and treats to feed your favorite PAW pals!
• Francois's Art Festival: Unleash your creativity at the Art Festival! Bring coloring pages to life and build collages with stickers earned from your adventures.

Take part in these Helping Paws minigames, where teamwork and kindness come first as pups respond to calls from friendly Adventure Bay citizens:

• Use Chase's tennis ball launcher to lend a helping hand.
• Wield Marshall's water cannon to make a splash.
• Take flight in Skye's helicopter to spot hidden objects.
• Pilot Zuma's hovercraft and launch buoys to rescue Cap'n Turbot.
• Control Rocky's extender claw to repair Cap'n Turbot's ship.
• Drive Rubble's bulldozer to help feed the farm.

- Created by Spin Master.

apps.title: Bowling Jam
apps.summary:
Swipe, bowl and knock down every last pin!

Bowling Jam is bowling with a twist: every lane is a puzzle of pins, shelves, TNT and glass, and you only get a few balls to clear it.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Swipe up to bowl — the faster the swipe, the harder the throw
• Bend your swipe to curve the ball around posts and pits
• TNT pins blow up their neighbours — one hit can clear a whole rack
• Glass breaks when you hit it hard; knock out a shelf's legs and its pins come down
• Iron pins are heavy — aim at the plank in front of them
• Moving platforms carry their pins along, and bumpers bank the ball into the corners

100 hand-made lanes on a sunny beach, from your first strike to racks that take every ball you have — and new lanes keep coming after that.

Can you clear them all?

apps.title: Solitaire: Classic & Calm
apps.summary:
Find your calm, one card at a time.

Solitaire: Classic & Calm brings the familiar charm of Klondike solitaire to your everyday breaks. Settle into a classic card game, consider your next move, and enjoy the satisfaction of bringing order to the deck.

THE CLASSIC YOU KNOW
Arrange cards in alternating colors, uncover hidden cards, and build each suit from Ace to King. Familiar rules make it easy to begin, while each deal gives you a new puzzle to work through.

A LITTLE FOCUS. A LITTLE CALM.
Take a break from a busy day with a game that invites you to slow down and think. Whether you have a few minutes to spare or time for a longer pause, make room for a little solitaire.

SIMPLE RULES, THOUGHTFUL MOVES
Decide which cards to uncover and when to make space for a King. Every choice is part of the pleasure, from your opening move to the final card in a completed game.

YOUR EVERYDAY CARD BREAK
Enjoy a quiet moment over morning coffee, between tasks, or as you wind down for the evening. Solitaire: Classic & Calm is a familiar companion for anyone who enjoys a classic card puzzle.

Make your next break a calm one. Play Solitaire: Classic & Calm.

apps.title: Line Tangle: Untangle Puzzle
apps.summary:
Love casual games? Discover Line Tangle, a relaxing mobile game where you drag dots to untangle lines and reveal pictures. Follow colorful lines through each thread jam, clear the crossings, and watch a familiar shape emerge. Easy controls help you get started, while new levels give the tangle master in you more to explore.

Look at the board, choose a dot, and see how its connections move. As you untangle lines, each adjustment can help you find your next step. A thread jam may look tricky at first, but careful moves bring the design into focus. Work with colorful lines and build your skills as a tangle master through simple, hands-on play.

GAME FEATURES
• Simple controls, fresh challenges
Touch and drag to untangle lines, then check how the layout changes. Start with easier stages before taking on more intricate designs. Each thread jam offers a new arrangement of colorful lines to work through. You do not need to be a tangle master to enjoy your first level: just follow the connections and try a move.

• Pictures worth discovering
Flowers, leaves, buildings, faces, and more are hidden in the tangles. Move colorful lines into place and untangle lines to reveal the finished shape. Solving a thread jam gives you more than a cleared board: it uncovers a picture. Which design will you discover next as you practice becoming a tangle master?

• Clear visuals for relaxed play
A soft cream background makes colorful lines easy to follow as you untangle lines. The clean screen keeps your attention on the current thread jam and the effects of each move. Whether you are learning the basics or playing like a tangle master, enjoy a casual game with a clear goal and bright designs.

Take a short gaming break or settle in for a few more levels. Explore your next thread jam, follow the colorful lines, and untangle lines one crossing at a time. Enjoy the small wins along the way as you become a tangle master. Ready for another picture? Download Line Tangle and start playing today!

apps.title: Ring Tangle - Circle Puzzle
apps.summary:
Welcome to a colorful world of clever ring puzzles!

Rotate, align, and untangle each puzzle by moving colorful rings, loops, and linked shapes into the right position. Every level is a relaxing spatial challenge where you need to look carefully, find the open path, and work out how each piece fits together.

Enjoy smooth, satisfying puzzle gameplay as rings rotate into place, pieces separate, and complex structures slowly become clear. With simple tap-and-drag controls, Ring Tangle is easy to learn, relaxing to play, and full of clever logic puzzles to master.
Discover a wide variety of colorful puzzle layouts, from simple rings to more complex loops, frames, and interlocking shapes. Take on new challenges, use helpful hints when you need them, and keep your mind active with every puzzle you solve.

GAME FEATURES

Relaxing rotate-and-untangle puzzle gameplay
Satisfying spatial logic challenges
Colorful rings, loops, and interlocking shapes
Simple tap-and-drag controls
Clever puzzles that become more challenging over time
Smooth animations and satisfying unlock moments
Helpful hints for tricky levels
Quick puzzle levels for playing anytime
A calm and rewarding brain-training experience

apps.title: Just a Squire
apps.summary:
You’re just a squire.

Do the chores. Earn your wages. Buy and merge powerful skills. Transform against impossible odds. Fall in love. And somehow… save the kingdom that ignored you.

All while everyone else gets the glory.

WELCOME TO JUST A SQUIRE

Just a Squire is a story-driven roguelite RPG about an underappreciated squire determined to prove that even the most ordinary person can become a hero.

Your adventure begins with simple duties and a knight who expects far too much. But when strange enemies appear and a mysterious power awakens within you, carrying the bags becomes the least of your problems.

TURN CHORES INTO GOLD

A squire’s work is never finished. At least this time, you’re getting paid.

Tackle playful timing and physics-based mini-games that turn everyday duties into satisfying challenges. Aim carefully, time your moves and earn gold for your hard work. Apparently, saving the kingdom doesn’t excuse you from chores.

BUY, MERGE AND CHOOSE YOUR SKILLS

Build your strategy as each chapter unfolds. Buy skills, merge them into stronger versions and choose combinations that work together.

Spend wisely, adapt to the skills on offer and decide which upgrades deserve your gold. Your next purchase could bring the whole build together.

UNLEASH YOUR TRANSFORMATIONS

Discover different Squire Forms and awaken powerful transformations at unforgettable story moments. Explore new looks, reveal the strength hiding inside you and show everyone what a “mere squire” can really do.

You might look a little different afterward. The chores will still be waiting.

MAKE YOUR SQUIRE YOUR OWN

Collect and upgrade equipment, try different combinations and give your squire a look worth remembering.

Discover Fate gear inspired by the different lives your squire could have lived. From humble jobs to distinctive clans, each look brings another possibility to your adventure. Apparently, being underappreciated comes in several outfits.

COLLECT PETS, MOUNTS AND SENTINELS

Expand your collection with charming pets, impressive mounts and powerful sentinels. Find your favorites and give your adventure a little more company.

Even a squire deserves someone on their side.

TAKE ON SOLO CHALLENGES AND PVP

Venture beyond the story with single-player modes and test your strength against other players in PvP battles.

Put your growing collection and carefully chosen upgrades to work across different challenges. Fight through beautiful fantasy arenas, face strange enemies and find more reasons to get stronger.

LIVE YOUR OWN FANTASY STORY

Meet memorable heroes, rivals, inventors, knights and monsters across unfolding chapters. Survive your knight’s increasingly ridiculous requests. Form unexpected friendships. Fall in love.

Uncover the truth behind a growing darkness and become the unlikely hero standing between the kingdom and an ancient evil.

You may begin as the least important person in the kingdom…

But you won’t stay that way for long.

Welcome to the Storywood Library. Each book shows a word or a picture — and every one belongs to a secret category. Trees. Cheeses. Cities. Animals. Emotions. Spot the link, stack the books that go together, and fill every library guest's order before your moves run out.

- Drag books onto each other to build matching stacks
- Fill each reader's order to send them home happy
- Clear the library level before your moves run out
- Undo and hint boosters for when a puzzle gets tight

FEATURES

- Hundreds of association puzzles, from gentle to genuinely brain-bending
- Words and pictures to connect: food, animals, geography, myth, science, sport
- A warm, hand-illustrated library full of charming readers

apps.title: Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam
apps.summary:
Sort colored sand, free your blocks, and fill every one of them to 100%. Sand Hole: Block Sort Jam is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the sand really moves.

HOW IT WORKS
Every level gives you framed panels full of colored sand and a board full of colored blocks. Drag a block until it touches sand of its own color and it starts pulling that sand in, grain by grain. Fill a block to 100% and it pops off the board, freeing space for the rest. Clear all the sand and the level is yours.

One finger, one gesture. Drag. That is the whole control scheme.

THE SAND DOES THE WORK
This sand is not a flat picture. Pull from underneath a pile and it funnels down into a V. Pull from the side and the slope above it slides. A steep, sharp edge will stand there until something gives, then collapse all at once. Drain the same panel in a different order and it falls apart differently.

A REAL PUZZLE UNDER THE COLORS
Blocks cannot pass through each other, and a long shape wedged in a corridor stays wedged. So the order you complete blocks in is the actual puzzle: read the board, spot the block that frees the most room, and work outward from there.

Boards come in every shape, from open grids to narrow corridors and split chambers, and later levels keep several sand panels going at once. Some blocks even hold a second color inside: the inner layer fills first, then the outer one takes over.

The timer only starts when you make your first move, so study the board as long as you want before you touch anything.

BOOSTERS FOR THE TIGHT SPOTS
Hammer: splits a stuck block into single cells that slip through any gap.
Magnet: fills the selected block instantly and pops it.
Time Freeze: stops the clock while everything else keeps running.

FEATURES
- Satisfying color sort puzzle built on real sand physics
- Drag only controls, playable with one thumb
- Blocks in every shape: bars, squares, L shapes, T shapes
- Boards that keep changing shape: corridors, chambers, open grids
- Multiple sand panels running at the same time in later levels
- Bright pixel style sand in clean, saturated colors
- Three boosters: Hammer, Magnet, Time Freeze
- No wall of tutorials, you learn it in one drag

Drag, pull, pop. Your satisfying sand sort puzzle is ready when you are.

apps.title: 8 Ball Legend
apps.summary:
Realistic physics, responsive controls, and pool tables with a creative twist. Easy to pick up and packed with challenges, this is a 3D 8-ball pool game you’ll want to keep coming back to.

Welcome to 8 Ball Legend, a completely free 3D pool puzzle game made for unwinding, one level at a time. Join millions of pool players and discover the simple satisfaction of lining up a shot and watching the ball drop into the pocket. Whether you’re picking up a cue for the first time or fine-tuning your angles and power, there’s a single-player arcade challenge for you.

🎯 Realistic physics, satisfying shots
Watch the balls roll and collide naturally thanks to realistic physics. Plan your shots with AI-assisted trajectory feedback. Clear aiming lines and smooth cue controls help you fine-tune your aim, adjust your shot power, and apply spin to the cue ball. Enjoy the satisfying sound of a ball dropping into the pocket.

🎱 Easy to learn, rewarding to master
Aim, take your shot, and pocket the ball. The basics are simple, but there’s always room to improve. Adjust your angle and power, experiment with bank shots and trick shots to find clever paths to the pocket, and see how far your pool skills can take you.

🗺️ Plenty of levels, tables with a twist
Explore 3D 8-ball pool tables in imaginative shapes that give the game an arcade twist. Each new layout is a puzzle to solve: study the table, plan your shots, and work your way through hundreds of levels.

🎁 Collect cues and unlock new settings
Beat levels, collect legendary cues and valuable items, and discover a variety of themed settings. There’s always something new to look forward to as you progress.

📱 No Wi-Fi? No problem
Play single-player 8-ball pool levels offline whenever you feel like it. On your commute, during a break, or while traveling, a relaxing game of pool is always within reach.

🏆 Make your mark on the global leaderboard
Sharpen your skills, beat your best scores, and climb the global leaderboard. How high can you go?

✨ Detailed visuals, immersive sound
Rich lighting, carefully crafted settings, and the crisp sound of colliding balls bring every pool table to life.

Ready to take your shot? Pick up your cue, make a great break shot, and discover what’s next. Your journey to becoming an 8-ball pool legend starts here!

apps.title: Invokers: Titan Legacy
apps.summary:
Hack and slash your way through a vibrant fantasy world, battling epic bosses and hundreds of different enemies along the way. Crush waves of skeletons, goblins, and ogres – then face off against fearsome dragons, colossal giants, deadly demons, and much more.

Explore a vast world and discover a huge variety of stunning locations and enemies. Craft your perfect team: summon legendary Invokers and powerful Titans and experience the most exciting Action RPG combat on mobile – this is a true AAA mobile game. Adventure across tons of levels and beat huge dungeon bosses to win the best loot.

COLLECT INVOKERS & TITANS

Summon over a hundred Invokers from a variety of different Factions and customize your fantasy team: play as orcs, elves, humans – or someone a little more furry. And that's not all – summon powerful Titans and bind them to your Invokers to call upon legendary power.

INVOKE TITANS

When the time's right, unleash the ultimate power – Invoke a Titan and transform into a super powered fantasy creature to take down anything that stands in your way.

FIGHT EPIC BOSS BATTLES

Face off against classic monsters and bosses and experience the best boss battles on mobile! Go to war against the terrifying Corrupted Dragon, the cold-hearted Ice Queen, the merciless Demon Lord, and many more – in the best Action MMORPG battles around.

FAST-PACED ACTION COMBAT

Don't waste time taking turns – Invokers: Titan Legacy is all-action, all the time. Invokers takes all the tactics and strategy of turn-based battle RPGs, but boosts the excitement to a new level with fast, flashy, action gameplay.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR TEAM

With billions of different team combinations and ways to develop your Invokers, you can play exactly how you want. Equip your team with powerful relics, then upgrade their skills to fit your strategy and tactics – bring deadly attackers, tough tanks, helpful healers, powerful sorcerers, or whatever you need to take down your next target.

CLIMB THE SPIRES

Craft the perfect strategy and build your teams to climb the towers to glory. Each legendary elemental tower requires a fully custom team. Master the elements and claim your victory.

PLAY YOUR WAY

Play how you want – whenever, wherever. Take full control of every Invoker, every skill, and every ability – or play on Auto mode to kick back, relax, and watch your awesome team do their thing.

And no internet, no problem. You can play Invokers offline – no matter where you are in the world. On a plane? At the bottom of the sea? Upgrade your experience with non-stop action-packed Invokers battles.

STUNNING 3D GRAPHICS

From the gorgeous, fully-animated 3D characters to the richly detailed, vibrant biomes, Invokers offers a vivid world you can immerse yourself in. And with thousands of unique skill animations and effects, action RPG combat has never looked more exciting.

EXPLORE A DEEP FANTASY WORLD

Get to know every Invoker in Amara, with fully fleshed out lore and bios for every single character – along with an expansive world map to discover. The world of Invokers is deep, complex, and rich with story.

apps.title: Dead Ahead: Roadside
apps.summary:
Dead Ahead: Roadside – Pixel Text-based Roguelike Adventure

The legendary Dead Ahead universe is back! 10M+ players have joined the franchise, but in this brand-new zombie game, most will still end up as bait for the hungry zombies. 🍖🍴
Can you survive the road, or will this classic pixel rpg mark your final stop? 🧟‍♂️

Key Features:

🎮 Chill & Savage 🎮
Face the post-apocalyptic world at your own pace. If you love casual idle games, you can master the loop day by day with seamless controls. Just pick your perks, sit back, and watch your squad carve through relentless zombie waves in one of the most exciting zombie apocalypse games around.

🤩 Choice & Consequence 💪
Every day on the road brings a new decision. Risk it all for a rare reward or play it safe and move on? Your choices in these random encounters shape every run. It is a dangerous walking dead world out there, but taking risks is the only way to progress in this deep roguelike pixel rpg.

⛏️ Perks & Builds ⚒️
Unlock game-changing perks and craft a lethal build for every encounter. Experiment with synergies on the fly – every run is a new combination. Build the ultimate setup to survive the brutal zombie waves and prove your tactical skills.

🤯 Roam & Ruin 🌍
Each run takes you deeper into the ruined world. Push through wrecked cities, highways, and swamps, adapting to shifting threats. No two runs are ever the same in these vast adventure games, making it a standout entry among modern zombie games.

🤝 Friends & Firepower 💥
Unlike most zombie apocalypse games, this road is not yours to walk alone. Recruit fellow survivors who fight by your side with skills of their own. Level up your crew, unlock their perks, and get ready to fight back the walking dead hordes.

💰 Idle & Armed 🎖️
Collect your AFK rewards and gear up. As one of the most satisfying idle rpg games on mobile, every return makes you stronger. Unlock unique gear for your idle zombie build and prepare for the road ahead.

Will you survive this roguelike zombie game with brains… or just bullets? 🧟‍♂️
Enjoy these idle rpg games! The adventure games and idle games mechanics blend with pixel-style zombie games. Build your ultimate idle zombie hunting squad and defeat the zombies!

apps.title: Hoop Life:Idle Game
apps.summary:
WELCOME TO HOOP STAR: IDLE CLICKER – THE ULTIMATE BASKETBALL RISE!
Step into the world of JORDEN, an unknown street baller with nothing but a worn-out court, a ball, and a dream to become a legend. In this addictive idle clicker and life simulator, you’ll grind your way from street games to the pro stage—rising from “the kid nobody passes to” into a global basketball icon and business tycoon.
FROM STREET COURTS TO THE SPOTLIGHT
JORDEN starts with nothing but grit and determination. Watch his journey from zero to hero as he battles through intense games and relentless training. Every tap brings you closer to turning doubt into dominance and becoming the center of attention on the court.
SHOW YOUR MOVES, OWN THE GAME
Dominate the court with your skills! Hold to dribble, shoot, and dunk your way to highlight plays that fire up the crowd. In intense 1v1 shooting battles, face off against your opponents. Time your shots and score more baskets within the limit to win. Each victory boosts your leaderboard rank, taking you from unknown to the top.
BUILD YOUR BASKETBALL EMPIRE
As your fame grows, so does your income. Upgrade elite training facilities, unlock stylish gear and signature sneakers, and refine your skills to perfection. Balance training and competition to turn JORDEN into not just a star player—but a true business powerhouse.
LIVE THE PRO PLAYER LIFE
This is more than just basketball—it’s a full life simulation. Meet teammates, face rivals, handle pressure, and make key decisions that shape your career. Will you rise to MVP greatness or fade as a one-hit wonder? The choice is yours.
KEY FEATURES:
● Highlight Plays: Perform flashy moves and dominate the crowd
● Idle Progression: Train and earn rewards even while offline
● Tycoon System: Upgrade facilities, gear, and performance
● Life Simulator: Experience the highs and lows of a pro career
● Rise to Glory: Go from street baller to global legend
● Star Journey: Build your fame, skills, and legacy

apps.title: Crowd Theory
apps.summary:
How well do you know the crowd?

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. Lock your guess, no takebacks, and watch the reveal - the crowd's true number, live, and your score is how far away you are. 2% away? You can read the room. 45% off? Maybe you've been living under a rock.

THE DAILY RITUAL

• One new question every day at 4pm ET - everyone plays the same 24-hour window
• Questions you can't help guessing: What percent of people think they're better-than-average drivers? What percent refrigerate ketchup? What percent fart in front of their spouse? What percent say please and thank you to AI?
• Live crowd numbers that move as votes come in

SEE WHO SAID WHAT

• Demographic breakdowns: how men, women, and every generation answered
• Daily takeaways on where the crowd split
• Every question ends in a conversation with the whole crowd

START A LEAGUE

• Your own private leaderboard with your group chat, your family, your office
• One link invites them - friends who have the app land straight in your league
• Finally settle who actually knows how people think

How well do you know the crowd?

Every day, one question. Answer it honestly for yourself - then the real game: predict what percent of everyone else said the same. Lock your guess, no takebacks, and watch the reveal - the crowd's true number, live, and your score is how far away you are. 2% away? You can read the room. 45% off? Maybe you've been living under a rock.

THE DAILY RITUAL

• One new question every day at 4pm ET - everyone plays the same 24-hour window
• Questions you can't help guessing: What percent of people think they're better-than-average drivers? What percent refrigerate ketchup? What percent fart in front of their spouse? What percent say please and thank you to AI?
• Live crowd numbers that move as votes come in

SEE WHO SAID WHAT

• Demographic breakdowns: how men, women, and every generation answered
• Daily takeaways on where the crowd split
• Every question ends in a conversation with the whole crowd
